tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Check remaining subscription, purchased and total credits in this workspace. Costs no credits. If credits are low, follow the pricing link to buy more.

tools.name: get_pricing_link
tools.description: Get Promptify's pricing page for credit packs and monthly plans. Costs no credits.

tools.name: render_ad
tools.description: First call with adId to get the real credit quote without spending. Show the user the cost and ask for approval. Only then call again with confirm: true and expectedCredits equal to totalCredits from the quote. A changed quote requires approval again. Uses the studio's paid render service; check pro

tools.name: list_ads
tools.description: The ads in this Promptify workspace: title, status, format, language, whether the user exported it, and real link clicks. Use it to answer 'what have I made' or to pick an ad to talk about.

tools.name: get_ad
tools.description: One ad in full: its hooks, its scene-by-scene script, and its model-native prompts. Use after list_ads when the user wants the actual content.

tools.name: get_ad_stats
tools.description: What this workspace has MADE, what it EXPORTED (downloaded — the only activation signal), and real CLICKS on its Promptify short links, grouped by format and language. Clicks may be compared between the user's own ads; they are NOT a rate — there are no impressions, CTR, spend or ROAS anywhere in th

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Promptify's ad template library: each is a hook device plus a timed beat structure (e.g. 'skeptic-converts', 'negative hook', 'problem-agitate-solve'). Pass a template's id to generate_ad_script to build the ad on that structure. These are craft patterns, not proven winners — no template has perform

tools.name: get_brand_profile
tools.description: The workspace's saved brand profile — category, channels, languages, markets, preferred model. Read it before proposing an ad so the suggestion fits what they actually sell.

tools.name: scrape_product
tools.description: Read a product page and return its title, description and price. Costs no credits. Use this before generating so the ad is grounded in what the page actually says, instead of what the model assumes.

tools.name: draft_ad_plan
tools.description: Estimate an ad plan before anything is spent, using the render engine's cost tables. For a saved ad's exact remaining cost, call render_ad with adId and no confirmation. Starting a render requires the user to approve that quote.

tools.name: generate_ad_script
tools.description: Generate a full ad script package for a product: 10 hooks, a scene-by-scene script, and model-native video prompts (Veo/Kling). Costs about 2-3 credits, metered and refunded in full if it fails. This CREATES an ad in the user's Promptify workspace and returns a link to it — it does not render video.
